modules.title: Fundamental pillars of the training program

lessons.title: Plans with going to
lessons.description: Talk about plans with going to and time markers.

lessons.title: Hotel questions and reservations
lessons.description: Ask hotel questions and make a reservation.

lessons.title: Free time
lessons.description: Make small talk about free time with like and enjoy plus -ing.

lessons.title: Buying things
lessons.description: Ask and answer questions about buying things.

lessons.title: Holidays, apologies and problems
lessons.description: Say what you did on vacation, what is happening now, apologise and solve a problem.

lessons.title: Tickets, health and clothes
lessons.description: Buy a ticket, describe symptoms, talk about clothes and everyday life.

lessons.title: Small talk
lessons.description: Make small talk with old and new acquaintances.

lessons.title: Skills and abilities
lessons.description: Say what people can and cannot do.

lessons.title: On the telephone
lessons.description: Answer the telephone and deal with a difficult person.

lessons.title: Advice and feelings
lessons.description: Ask for and give advice with should and express feelings.

lessons.title: Sustainable tourism
lessons.description: Talk about saving water and energy with the present simple and imperatives.

lessons.title: Tourism for peace
lessons.description: Use basic questions and social formulas.

lessons.title: Tourism service
lessons.description: Make functional requests at check-in, check-out and in a restaurant.
